60-12-2. Employment of child under fourteen years of age restricted--Violation as misdemeanor.

No child under fourteen years of age may be employed at any time in any factory or workshop or about any mine, nor be employed in any mercantile establishment except during hours when the child's own school or other educational program is not in session and in no case after seven o'clock p.m. Violation of this section is a Class 2 misdemeanor.

Write a bill that would update 60-12-2 to nine pm instead of seven pm.
model_output:
Here's a draft bill to update the current law:

Title: Updating the Employment Restrictions for Children Under Fourteen Years of Age

Section 1. Amendment of 60-12-2

Subsection 1. Employment Restrictions

No child under fourteen years of age may be employed at any time in any factory or workshop or about any mine, nor be employed in any mercantile establishment except during hours when the child's own school or other educational program is not in session and in no case after nine o'clock p.m.

Subsection 2. Penalties

Violation of this section shall be a Class 2 misdemeanor.

Section 2. Effective Date

This bill shall take effect immediately upon passage.

Note: This bill is a proposed update to the current law in South Dakota, 60-12-2, which restricts the employment of children under fourteen years of age. The proposed update changes the employment restrictions from seven o'clock p.m. to nine o'clock p.m.
